Spain Wins FIFA World Cup Amidst Post-Match Brawl and Fan Celebrations

Spain won the 2026 FIFA World Cup, defeating Argentina 1-0 in the final held in New Jersey. Following the match, Argentina's Leandro Paredes was sent off after a confrontation with Spanish players. Celebrations for Spain's victory occurred across India, including in Hyderabad and cities in Kerala and Maharashtra, with fireworks and public gatherings. However, a celebration in Ciudad Rodrigo, Spain, turned tragic with the death of a teenager.
